# SuperPage

> SuperPage is a no-code website builder for UK small businesses. The idea is simple: you don't need to be super at anything — SuperPage (your nerdy superhero) has already built and structured everything. You just fill in your business details and you're online in minutes.

## What is SuperPage?

SuperPage helps UK small businesses get online without any technical knowledge. Think of it like a digital business card — you don't need to know how to print it, you just hand it over. SuperPage does the same for your website.

- No coding required
- No expensive web agency needed
- Professional website live in minutes
- Custom domain support (.co.uk, .com)
- Free for the first year

## Who is it for?

Any UK small business that needs to be found online: cleaners, hairdressers, restaurants, personal trainers, tradespeople, freelancers, beauty salons, delivery services, and more.

## Key pages

- Homepage: https://superpage.co.uk/
- Create a free account: https://superpage.co.uk/auth/register
- Sign in: https://superpage.co.uk/auth/login
- Sitemap: https://superpage.co.uk/sitemap.xml

## Pricing

SuperPage is free for the first year for your first site. No credit card required.
